limitations: Only nine confidently visible balls across 120 samples (7.5% coverage). Buffalo 900/1800s and North Shore 1800s are stoppages, and netting, blur or camera framing limit others. Correlated short clips, not independent human ground truth; insufficient to establish whole-video reliability. Unknown excluded, not negative.
center_match: Within max(4, min(12, mean reviewed box half-size)) original pixels of reviewed point. Each extra or mismatched detection on a visible-ball frame is false positive; unknown frames are excluded.
